description: This file defines an interface 'WizardInterface' related to conditional formatting wizard functionality within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It specifies method signatures for manipulating cell ranges, styles, and conditional logic used in spreadsheet formatting.

classes.name: WizardInterface
classes.description: An interface that outlines the methods for managing conditional formatting wizard features, such as cell range selection, style application, and conditional logic handling.

methods.name: getCellRange
methods.description: Returns the current cell range over which the wizard is applied.

methods.name: setCellRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range for the conditional formatting wizard.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style object associated with the conditional formatting.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Assigns a style object to the conditional formatting.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Indicates whether the subsequent rules should be skipped if the condition is true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets whether to stop evaluating further rules when the current condition is true.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Retrieves the conditional object representing the rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an instance of the wizard from an existing Conditional object and an optional cell range.
